h1: B2B Lead Generation for Pharma Distributors in Delhi
intro: Delhi NCR is a major hub for pharma and medical-supply distribution, with wholesalers, stockists and traders across Okhla and the wider region. From our Mumbai HQ, we run managed cold email and LinkedIn outbound that books qualified meetings between pharma manufacturers, distributors and institutional buyers. See how we built [a shortlist of distribution partners in the UAE](/case-studies/pharma-uae-distribution-partners) and [₹48 lakh in pipeline for a contract pharma manufacturer](/case-studies/pharma-contract-manufacturer-pipeline). For the Mumbai side, see [pharma lead generation in Mumbai](/b2b-lead-generation-pharma-mumbai).

faqs.q: Do you work with pharma distributors as well as manufacturers?
faqs.a: Yes. We run outreach for manufacturers seeking distributors and for distributors seeking new suppliers and portfolios.

faqs.q: Can you find distribution partners outside India?
faqs.a: Yes. We have built distributor shortlists in export markets such as the UAE.

faqs.q: Do you contact patients or consumers?
faqs.a: No. We work only on B2B pharma: manufacturers, distributors, institutional buyers and suppliers.

faqs.q: How do you handle regulated messaging?
faqs.a: Messaging stays factual and avoids claims. We align copy with your regulatory and quality teams before launch.

faqs.q: How does your Mumbai team work with Delhi clients?
faqs.a: Through shared Slack or WhatsApp channels, weekly KPI reviews and live CRM and calendar integrations.
